components.name: Meta Chip

components.html: 45 min

components.name: Meta Chip (small)

components.html: 620 cal

components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; width: 220px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #e8e3db; border-radius: 9999px; background: #faf8f5; transition: border-color 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #f0b429; background: #ffffff; } .ds-search-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; color: #6f6862; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-search:focus-within .ds-search-icon { color: #8a5310; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #131110; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #6f6862; } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase wide-tracked label with a 2px underline that turns gold when active.
components.html: RecipesIngredientsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 36px; } .ds-nav-link { padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #6f6862; text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; transition: color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #131110; border-bottom-color: #e8e3db; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #131110; border-bottom-color: #f0b429; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5310; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Accent Link
components.description: The 'see all' affordance. Gold-deep text with an arrow that travels 4px on hover.
components.html: See all 42
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #8a5310; text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-link:hover { color: #131110; } .ds-link-arrow { width: 16px; height: 16px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-link:hover .ds-link-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5310; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-link-arrow { transition: none; } .ds-link:hover .ds-link-arrow { transform: none; } }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; width: 260px; } .ds-card-link { text-decoration: none; display: block; } .ds-card-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a5310; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-card-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: #faf8f5; } .ds-card-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8e3db, #d8d2c8); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-link:hover .ds-card-img { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-card-title { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.375; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #131110; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-decoration-color: #8a5310; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-card-link:hover .ds-card-title { text-decoration-line: underline; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 8px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

narrative.overview:
This is one cook's working record, published. The page behaves like a well-kept
notebook left open on a counter: white paper, a warm off-white for anything set
aside from the page, hairline rules where a notebook would have printed lines,
and a single gold accent that functions the way a pencil underline does — it
marks the thing the author is vouching for, and it means nothing if it is
everywhere.

Nothing here is styled to look expensive. The surface is deliberately quiet so
that photography and the recipe titles carry all of the visual weight. Depth is
achieved by ruling and tonal steps, never by shadow: a card is separated from the
page because it sits on `wash` (#faf8f5) inside a 1px `rule` (#e8e3db) border, not
because it floats above it. Type does the shouting — Archivo at 800 weight with
tight negative tracking gives titles a compressed, editorial compaction, while
Inter handles every piece of running text and every label at sizes that survive a
glance from an arm's length away.

The reading scene is a constraint, not a flourish. A cook is standing up, hands
busy, phone or laptop propped at a distance, looking for their place between
steps. That is why meta information (time, calories, brand picks) is set in pill
chips with tabular numerals rather than in a paragraph, why hit targets stay
generous, and why the accent color is reserved rather than decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white ground (#ffffff) with wash (#faf8f5) as the only recessed surface.
Zero shadows anywhere; 1px hairline rules and tonal steps carry all separation.
One accent hue in two roles: gold (#f0b429) for marks and states, gold-deep (#8a5310) for anything text-sized that must stay legible.
Archivo 800 with -0.035em tracking for titles; Inter for everything else.
Uppercase, wide-tracked (0.14em-0.24em) Inter for nav and eyebrow labels.
Motion is limited to a 1.03 image scale and 200ms color transitions, always with a motion-reduce escape.

rules.name: The Underline Rule
rules.body: Gold marks endorsement and state, nothing else. If an element is gold and is neither the active thing, the focused thing, nor the thing the author is standing behind, remove the gold.

rules.name: The Two Golds Rule
rules.body: gold (#f0b429) is for marks, borders, and fills seen at a glance; gold-deep (#8a5310) is for anything read as text or drawn as an icon. Never set text in #f0b429 on a light ground.

rules.name: The Two Surfaces Rule
rules.body: The system has exactly two grounds - paper and wash. A third tone is not a new token, it is a mistake.

rules.name: The Tight-Title Rule
rules.body: Every Archivo setting carries negative tracking scaled to its size (-0.02em at 17px, -0.035em at 28px and above). Archivo at default tracking looks unset in this system.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any numeral a cook compares across cards - times, calories, counts - is set tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Equal-Height Rule
rules.body: In the lg two-column band both cards stretch to a shared height; the ingredient card's list uses auto-rows-fr and flex-1 so the extra height is absorbed by the thumbnails, never by trailing whitespace.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is not part of this system, at rest or in any state. If an element needs separation, it gets a rule or a tonal step.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border in the system is exactly 1px #e8e3db. The only exceptions are the 2px gold underline on the active nav link and the 2px focus-visible outline.

dos: Do separate surfaces with a 1px #e8e3db rule or the #ffffff to #faf8f5 tonal step - the two mechanisms this system has.
Do set every Archivo heading with negative tracking (-0.02em at 17px, -0.035em at 28px+).
Do use gold-deep (#8a5310) for any accent that will be read as text or drawn as an icon, and gold (#f0b429) only for marks, borders, and fills.
Do put time and calories on every surface where a recipe is shown, in tabular-nums meta chips.
Do pair every transform or transition with a motion-reduce variant.
Do give every interactive element a focus-visible gold-deep outline.
Do clip images with a fixed-aspect overflow-hidden container and object-cover.
donts: Don't add box-shadow to anything, in any state.
Don't introduce a third surface tone, a fourth radius, or a second accent hue.
Don't set body text or small text in #f0b429 - it fails contrast on light grounds.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure gray; ink is warm (#131110) and muted is warm (#6f6862).
Don't introduce a serif or a third typeface; the pairing is Archivo + Inter.
Don't let the accent spread - if more than a few percent of a screen is gold, the Underline Rule is being broken.
Don't invent testimonials, ratings, counts, or badges; the site has no social proof and must not imply any.
